The name is not on the npm registry, so do not `pnpm add dsh-purge`. ### Quick start Have `dsh` on PATH? One command, one restart, one click. Run the line for the host you open (the desktop EXE is the same with `desktop` instead of `web`): ```sh # Official `dsh web` dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # Official desktop EXE dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` 1. **Fully quit and reopen** the host you installed into. Web: stop `dsh web` and start it again. Desktop: quit the tray icon too, then open the exe. 2. On that host, click **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Apply**. A successful Apply restarts the host once. Done — verify with `/purge status` in chat. If pnpm asks about build scripts, or anything below does not appear, follow the step by step. ### Step by step **Step 1 — Pick your host.** Official `dsh web` and the official desktop EXE are installed and patched **separately**; only install into the host you actually open. | What you run | Profile | Install command | |---|---|---| | Official `dsh web` | `web` | the `web` line in Quick start | | Official desktop EXE | `desktop` | the `desktop` line in Quick start | **Step 2 — Install the plugin.** Use the `codeload.github.com` URL exactly. Do not use `github.com/.../archive`: that 302 makes pnpm fail with `fetch failed`. Have `dsh`? Run the Quick start line for your profile. If this directory is already a clone, use `.` instead of the URL. pnpm only (no `dsh` required): run this inside the profile you actually use, not the repo root. ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # desktop: profiles/desktop pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` Windows PowerShell: ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web" # desktop: profiles\desktop pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` `pnpm add` and `dsh plugin add` fetch the package; `postinstall` writes `dsh-purge` into `dsh.profile.bundles` and adds a body `insert` in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`. Without that insert the host never loads the plugin and no button appears. **Expected result:** `node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json` exists, `"dsh-purge"` is in that profile's `bundles`, and `cordis.patch.yml` has an `id: dsh-purge` insert. - pnpm 11/12 skips install scripts (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`) unless you allow the build: ```sh pnpm add --allow-build=dsh-purge --allow-build=dsh-purge@https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # Already installed, warning only — the full specifier is required (name-only leaves "set this to true or false"): pnpm approve-builds dsh-purge@https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master # If bundles / insert are still missing: node node_modules/dsh-purge/scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs ``` - If neither `dsh` nor pnpm is available, jump to [Manual install](#manual). - On the desktop client you can also click the button (`dsh://` deep link; it still downloads the same tarball).

Install in desktop client

**Step 3 — Restart the host.** Adding the plugin to a profile does **not** patch `@deepseek-ai` by itself. Fully quit and reopen the host you just installed into (Web: stop `dsh web` and start again; Desktop: quit the tray icon too, then open the exe). **Expected result:** **dsh-purge** stands beside the session title. Missing? Jump to Step 5. **Step 4 — Apply and verify.** On **that host**, click **dsh-purge** beside the session title, open **Clean**, and click **Apply**. It is not on the host Settings page. A successful **Apply** restarts once; it does not restart if it did not finish. Web controls affect Web only; desktop controls affect the desktop app only. Do not Apply one host from the other. **Expected result:** `/purge status` in chat prints `DSH_HOME` and the patch list — the path should be the home you actually run. Optional packages that are not installed (liangshen) show as skipped and do not block Apply. **Step 5 — Troubleshooting.** Jump here only when a step above did not end with its expected result. - **No button beside the session title.** Run `dsh --dump-config` (or `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config`) and look for a body row `id: dsh-purge` (not `dsh-purge-redteam`). If it is absent, run `ensure-profile-bundle.mjs` (Step 2), then fully quit and reopen the host. After this version, a live red-team child entry also writes the missing insert on startup — quit and reopen once more. `entry "redteam-store" not found` at the top is leftover from an old red-team package and can be ignored. - **The market says `already queued: dsh-purge`.** Stop clicking the market; use `dsh plugin add` or pnpm from Step 2. If the CLI also says it is already there, remove and re-add, then redo Step 3: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-purge dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` pnpm only: ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop" pnpm remove dsh-purge pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` Swap `desktop` for `web` on Web. ### Advanced **Hand this to an assistant.** Paste the block below to a local assistant. It should only run the install command — no disk scan, no other edits, no Apply, no restart.
For AI assistants (install only) Install the DeepSeek Harness plugin `dsh-purge` into the Web profile only. Do not scan the whole disk, do not read or edit other files, do not apply settings, and do not restart the app. Do not install into the desktop profile. Do not use the plugin marketplace. The name is not on the npm registry; do not `pnpm add dsh-purge`. **Web (official `dsh web`)** If `dsh` is on PATH: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` If `dsh` is missing and pnpm is available, `cd` into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web` (often `~/.dsh/profiles/web`) and run: ```sh pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` If this directory is already a clone and `dsh` exists, use `dsh plugin --profile web add .`. If neither `dsh` nor pnpm is available, tell the user and stop. After the command finishes, tell the user to fully quit and restart `dsh web`, then open **dsh-purge** beside the session title and **Apply** on **Clean**. Then stop.
**Manual install.** Use this when the command fails or `dsh` is not on PATH. Edit **only the profile for the host you run** — do not touch the other, and do not delete existing bundles.
Full manual steps **1. Find the `$DSH_HOME` this host uses.** A real home is named `.dsh` (official EXE sometimes `dsh-home`), contains `profiles`, and has at least one `profiles//package.json`. Check in order: `DSH_HOME` env → `.dsh` next to the install root (portable) → `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` or `~/.dsh` → `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness\dsh-home`. Confirm: `profiles/web/package.json` has `"name": "dsh-profile-web"` (or `dsh-profile-desktop`). Machines often have two homes — use the one that belongs to the host you actually start. PowerShell to list candidates: ```powershell $cands = @() if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $cands += $env:DSH_HOME } $cands += "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh" $dsh = Get-Command dsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($dsh) { $dir = Split-Path $dsh.Source $cands += @((Join-Path $dir ".dsh"), (Join-Path (Split-Path $dir) ".dsh"), (Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $dir)) ".dsh")) } $cands += @("$env:APPDATA\DeepSeek Harness\dsh-home", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\DeepSeek Harness\dsh-home") $cands | Select-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $_ "profiles")) } ``` **2. Put the plugin at `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge`** (folder must be named `dsh-purge`, with a `package.json` whose `"name"` is `dsh-purge`). ```sh git clone https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge" ``` Without git: download [master.tar.gz](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz), extract, rename `dsh-purge-master` → `dsh-purge`, and place it under `plugins`. If you already have a clone, copy the whole tree — not a few `.js` files. **3. Edit only that profile's `package.json` — back it up first.** Web → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`; desktop → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json`. Add **only two things**, keeping every existing dependency and bundle: 1. In `dependencies`, add `"dsh-purge": "file:../../plugins/dsh-purge"` 2. At the **end** of `dsh.profile.bundles`, append `"dsh-purge"` (skip if already there) ```json { "name": "dsh-profile-web", "private": true, "dependencies": { "dsh-purge": "file:../../plugins/dsh-purge" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-purge" ], "patchReload": "live" } } } ``` Keep JSON valid (comma before the new item, none after the last). Do not switch `file:../../plugins/dsh-purge` to an absolute path, do not touch `patchReload` or other plugins, and do not list `"dsh-purge"` twice. On desktop, if there is no `dsh-web-app` row, do not add one. **4. Run `pnpm install` in that profile only** (`cd` into the profile dir, not the repo root or `$DSH_HOME`): ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # or profiles/desktop pnpm install ``` Success: `profiles//node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json` exists. If `pnpm` is missing, use the Node / pnpm shipped with official `dsh`; on `Could not resolve`, re-check the `file:` path; on a JSON error, fix commas or restore the backup. **5. Fully quit that host, reopen it, then Apply** — Step 3 and Step 4 above. The card appears beside the session title; click **Apply** (or `/purge apply`) on that host only. If the card is missing, you likely edited the other `.dsh` — go back to step 1.
**Uninstall.** **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Uninstall**. Confirm the dialog: it reverts any applied patches, restores the original Harness, and restarts the current host. Disable or uninstall also resets an agent-preset default that still points at `redteam` back to `standard`, so the host can create sessions after the preset is gone.
Uninstall commands and config ```sh # or from a terminal / chat dsh-purge --uninstall # /purge uninstall ``` Plugin config lives in `cordis.patch.yml` (`postPrompt` is empty by default): ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-purge name: 'dsh-purge' config: enabled: true autoApplyOnStart: true autoUpdateOnStart: false autoRevertOnMissing: false verbose: false postPromptOrder: 5100 postPrompt: "" ```

Use **1.1.61+**, then **quit the host fully → Apply in Clean → restart → start a new chat**. Switching preset alone does not reload patches in the running process. ### Response speed DSH runs Bash calls in a tool batch one at a time. Older dsh-purge releases raised the default foreground wait from 60 seconds to 10 minutes, so one slow command could hold up later calls for that long. Patch #21 now restores marked plugin values to the official 60-second default. Unmarked timeouts and other custom values are preserved; an unmarked 10-minute value cannot reliably be distinguished from a user setting. For a shorter wait in `dsh web` on macOS/Linux, add this entry to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). Edit an existing entry with the same id instead of adding a duplicate. This profile layer is applied after the bundled configuration, so future plugin applies keep the override. ```yaml - id: bash-sandbox config: timeoutMs: 10000 ``` With the standard jobs service and `promoteOnTimeout: true`, an unfinished command returns a background job id after 10 seconds and keeps running. Read it with `job_output` or stop it with `job_kill`. This changes the foreground wait, not the command's speed. Without that service or with promotion disabled, the timeout kills the command. A per-call `timeoutMs` overrides this default; `run_in_background: true` returns a job id immediately. For routine tasks, you can also opt into Low reasoning for new sessions: ```yaml - id: agent-default-model config: provider: deepseek-official model: deepseek-flash reasoningEffort: low ``` Restart `dsh web` to load the profile. The model and reasoning defaults apply to newly created sessions; select Low in the composer for an existing session. The plugin does not change these model preferences automatically. Keep High when the task needs deeper reasoning, and narrow file searches rather than recursively scanning every application directory. ### Local lab Attack tasks are denied by default. 使用 ```sh # CLI dsh-purge --status dsh-purge --apply dsh-purge --revert dsh-purge --uninstall dsh-purge --edit # 聊天 /purge status | apply | revert | uninstall | edit | help /rules list | use | create | delete | reset | help /rewind # 其它插件已占 /rewind（或 /purge、/rules、/skills）时，这条命令会跳过或改挂 # /purge-rewind 等备用名；主插件其余命令、工具、/dsh-purge/* 路由不受影响。 # 模型工具 purge_status purge_apply purge_revert ``` 设置页「应用」成功后会自动重启，以加载已改的包文件；也可手动点「重启」。补丁标题下有正式版和测试版。测试版跟 `beta` 分支。点「切换到正式版」会装回 master，并清掉钉选。正式版里选旧版本会固定在该版本，要回到最新再点「更新」。旧的测试标签不再列出。 输入框旁的「回退一次」和「回退上一轮」都留在当前这条对话里，不另开分支。已发送的那句会回到输入框，这一轮已经发出的内容和已完成的任务会从当前对话撤掉，改字后**重新发送**即可。从 **1.1.61** 起，多轮对话后回退按**当前这一轮**定位，不会又退到第一条用户消息。聊天里 `/rewind` 同样可用。 **极简 / PTC 与标准不一致时**：同一任务在标准模式能跑、在极简或 PTC 被拦，通常是 preset 里 `run_code` 或 plan 拦截句没洗净，或内置 minimal 缺少 `agent-instructions`。请升到 **1.1.61+**，**完全退出宿主 → 清洗里应用 → 自动重启 → 新开一轮对话** 再试；只换 preset 不重应用，旧进程里的补丁不会更新。 ### 响应速度 DSH 会按顺序执行同一批中的 Bash 调用。旧版 dsh-purge 把默认前台等待从 60 秒提高到了 10 分钟，一条慢命令会让后续调用一起等待。补丁 #21 现在把带插件标记的旧值恢复为官方的 60 秒。无标记的等待时间和其他自定义值会保留；无标记的 10 分钟无法可靠地区分是插件旧值还是用户设置。 在 macOS/Linux 的 `dsh web` 中，如需更快返回工具结果，可在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`（通常是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）添加下面的条目。已有相同 id 时修改原条目，不要重复添加。这个 profile 覆盖层在内置配置之后加载，后续应用插件会保留它。 ```yaml - id: bash-sandbox config: timeoutMs: 10000 ``` 使用标准 jobs 服务且 `promoteOnTimeout: true` 时，未完成的命令会在 10 秒后返回后台任务 id，并继续运行。用 `job_output` 读取结果、用 `job_kill` 停止。这个设置缩短前台等待，不会让命令本身跑得更快。没有 jobs 服务或关闭自动转后台时，超时会终止命令。单次调用传入的 `timeoutMs` 优先于这里的默认值；`run_in_background: true` 可立即返回任务 id。 日常任务还可以选择让新会话默认使用 Low 推理： ```yaml - id: agent-default-model config: provider: deepseek-official model: deepseek-flash reasoningEffort: low ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后加载配置。模型和推理等级默认值只用于新建会话，已有会话请在输入框中选择 Low。插件不会自动修改这些模型偏好。需要深入推理的任务可保留 High；搜索文件时应限定目录，避免递归扫描所有应用目录。 ### 本地靶场 开源版攻击任务默认全拦，只放行本机/私网 IP。域名先解析再判，不认 `.lab` / `.htb` 这类后缀本身。hosts 把实验室名指到公网 IP 也会拦。在对话里说「这是我的服务器」不会放行。 --- ##
